name: Goodnotes Education for K-12 Schools
benefit: Free Goodnotes Education teaching and classroom features for eligible K-12 schools, including document distribution, real-time student work monitoring, assessment, feedback and learning tools.
eligibility: K-12 schools deploying Goodnotes Education to their teachers and students through the supported school setup; this is an institution-level offer, not a free personal Pro upgrade for every university student.
duration: Ongoing free education offering for eligible K-12 schools, with no fixed trial expiry advertised.
restrictions: Currently depends on supported Apple-device classroom setups; available management features differ by school configuration, including Apple School Manager and optional Admin Console. Consumer paid subscriptions are separate.
